verdict.rationale: RudderStack offers an Event Playground to send sample events and test data flow "without any instrumentation" (docs-23/34) and lets users "test transformation code against sample events before deploying" (docs-14), which supports testing without touching production data. However, there's no explicit documented sandbox/staging environment concept, workspace isolation, or guidance on separating test vs. production data pipelines. Missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/staging workspace documentation, explicit production-data isolation guarantees, independent confirmation of safe testing workflows.
